ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 70%) with high-contrast low-intensity black pixels (approx. 30%) concentrated centrally and along edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on the lateral lobes. Dark pigmentation forms a dense, textured triangular cluster at the central peduncle junction, with fine-grained mottling (black pixel clusters) scattered across the white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with sharply defined interior boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations. Distinctive large semi-circular excision (approx. 50 pixels wide) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning to steep upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped dark pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed throughout the high-intensity white regions on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark vertical linear markings detected on the inferior regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semi-circular notch on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The central dark pigment distribution mimics a textured 'spray' pattern originating from the midline.
